notes.title: Future planning of the game
notes.notes:
游戏将在未来计划进行底层重构以便支持多人联机模式和更多的玩法内容，会作为新的可选启动项发布，可能会考虑更换游戏引擎（目前计划是虚幻5），敬请期待！
（另一个原因也是游戏表现不及预期，需要花时间进行改善）

In the future, the game will be reconstructed to support multiplayer online mode and more gameplay content, and will be released as a new optional startup item. It may consider changing the game engine (the current plan is Unreal 5), so stay tuned!
Another reason is that the performance of the game is not as good as expected, and it takes time to improve it.

notes.title: Small patches and comprehensive content updates
notes.notes:
Weakened the final boss *2.
Weakened the health and blood of most enemies.
More new extra content (+14)
Now audio will not be played when the game loses focus.
The special effects are optimized, and the game can run with less gpu.

削弱了最终boss *2
削弱了大部分敌人的生命值和血量
更多的新extra内容（+14）
现在在游戏失去焦点时不会播放音频
进行了特效的优化工作，游戏可以在占用更少gpu的情况下运行

notes.title: The game is officially released
notes.notes:
The game has been officially released
Due to limited personal energy, it may take some time to fix bugs and improve the current version, so people who buy from the first release may have to work hard and may encounter a lot of strange bugs
Remember to give feedback if you have any problems
If you have any opinions, you can also say
In short, thank you all for your support!
